label: Q01
question: Is knb-lter-cce.104 the correct EDI accession for this holding, or does it in fact describe the separate CCE-LTER POC/PON dataset, leaving the nitrate stable-isotope (delta-15N / delta-18O) dataset the CalOOS sheet names still unidentified?
context: CalOOS working sheet row 26 titles this holding "nitrate stable isotopes (N15/O18)" and gives knb-lter-cce.104 as its EDI accession, but EDI's own cite service (https://cite.edirepository.org/cite/knb-lter-cce.104.13?style=ESIP, checked 2026-09-05) titles knb-lter-cce.104 rev 13 "Particulate organic carbon and nitrogen measurements at selected depths in the water column in the CCE region since 2006 - ongoing" (Aluwihare). Checked 2026-10-06 against the package itself: its one entity (ParticulateOrganicCarbonandNitrogen, table_104.csv) holds C and N in ug/L and umol/L on 11 CCE Process cruises, and its EML abstract describes POC/PON by high-temperature combustion. There is no nitrate isotope column.
answer: knb-lter-cce.104 is the CCE Process-cruise POC/PON dataset, and this holding (cce-lter_poc-pon-cce-region) is ingested as that. The sheet's nitrate-isotope header and abstract were wrong for this row; the abstract is replaced with the EML's own. A nitrate stable-isotope dataset, if CalOOS wants one, is a separate holding with its own accession.
who: CalCOFI data team (inspection of the EDI package)

question: Duplicated rows: (a) P1604 cast 29 bottle 16 (25 m) is listed four times, identical in every column; (b) P1208MV cast 58 bottle 5 is listed twice with identical values but at 22 m (CCE event 503, 2012-08-20 23:38 UTC) and at 34 m (CCE event 509, 2012-08-21 02:01 UTC). Can you confirm (a) is a copy, and say which row of (b) is right?
context: The ingest drops the 3 extra copies in (a) and holds both rows of (b) out until answered. Every other bottle on P1208MV cast 58 carries CCE event 509 and time 02:01:45, and bottle 6 is at 24 m, so the 34 m row fits the cast; the 22 m row's event 503 belongs to an earlier deployment.
proposed_answer: (a) drop the copies; (b) the 34 m row (event 509) is cast 58 bottle 5, and the 22 m row (event 503) is a copy carried over from another cast.

question: Fifty-seven rows have no depth (P1106MV 26, P0810MV 20, P0704TN 5, P1208MV 3, P1408MV 2, P2402 1). Can you provide their depths?
context: Depth is a coordinate in the integrated database and is never guessed, so these 57 samples are held out. Checked 2026-10-06: on every one of these casts the depthless row is the highest bottle number on the cast, above its shallowest depth-labelled bottle (e.g. P1106MV cast 2 bottle 8 above bottle 7 at 10 m; P2402 cast 17 bottle 24 above bottle 18 at 14 m), so all 57 are near-surface samples.
proposed_answer: All 57 are the cast's surface sample (above its shallowest labelled bottle). Please supply the exact depth for each; until then they stay held out.
